title: Newsletter
conversion_notes: The page_intro section owns the single H1 via section_config.headingLevel=1. SubscribeForm renders NO heading of its own — the heading is NOT duplicated in the component section (and must not go into section_title, which would render as h2 and break the one-h1-per-page contract).

All form labels ('E-Mail-Adresse *', 'Name (optional)', 'Ich akzeptiere die Datenschutzbestimmungen *'), the submit label 'Abonnieren'/'Wird gesendet...', and success/error messages live inside frontend/components/forms/SubscribeForm.tsx (registered component 'subscribe_form') and are intentionally not part of the seed.
Page exports no metadata — 'seo' omitted; the layout default <title> applies today.
